subject: Sensing API and buttons you will place
body: I provide sensing.start(profile, onEvent, {source, targetEmotionId, mode}), a frame stream (1 Hz frames plus 5 s window features) for the live chart, sensing.manual() for the I'm-off button, and connectStrap() which must be called from a user click (Web Bluetooth rule). I will report false fires per minute per scenario for display. For M4 we pin sensing/scenarios/demo.json to your script timing together.
